decisions.evidence: R1 maker P1 'Save a bookmark: enter an address, it's stored and listed'. R1 client accepts baseline assumptions.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline presents save-by-url; conforms to reference.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'P3 — Edit & delete: correct details'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Generic edit presented and conforming; client later adds note/tag detail elsewhere.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'delete with a confirmation step'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Delete conforms; confirmation is an orthogonal UX extra.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'open a bookmark in a new tab'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Navigating to original url conforms (opening in a new tab is an equivalent variant).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'P3 — Organize with tags: apply tags'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Assigning tags presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'filter to one tag, clear the filter'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Filter-to-tag presented and conforming.

decisions.evidence: R1 maker baseline only 'Auto-fetches page titles'. R1 client: 'please try to collect its title, description, site icon, and preview image—not only its title.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline under-scoped metadata to title-only; client supplies the reference-conforming full metadata set (correct).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I should be able to adjust the title and description before saving and later.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Editing of auto-collected fields before/after save absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Saving the same address again should not create a duplicate. It should take me to the existing bookmark so I can edit it.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Duplicate-converges-to-edit missing from baseline; client requests the reference behaviour (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'The list should emphasize readability and show the title, description, tags, and site icon.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline list unspecified beyond 'list everything'; client adds readability-first list with required fields (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 maker 'search by title/address'. R1 client: 'Search should cover the title, description, note, and address'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Baseline search scope too narrow; client supplies full-text field set (correct).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'without caring about capitalization.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Case-insensitive search not in baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'richer searching: `#tag`'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. #tag search absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'combinations such as AND, OR, NOT, and parentheses.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Boolean/parenthesised search absent from baseline; client requests it (extend). Quoting-operator rule handled as a later separate decision.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'quoted exact phrases'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Quoted-phrase exact match absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'I need a “read later” state'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Read-later state absent from baseline; client requests it (extend). Default-state semantics decided separately at R3.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'with a separate unread view'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Separate unread view absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'and a way to mark items read.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Mark-as-read absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'selecting bookmarks for bulk changes, including changing tags, read status, archiving, and deleting.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Multi-select bulk actions absent from baseline; client requests them (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Applying an action to all matching results should respect the current search or filter.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bulk-apply-to-whole-filtered-collection absent from baseline; client requests the reference rule (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Please include sorting'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Sorting absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'a personal note, including formatted Markdown.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Markdown notes absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'preserve a local copy of a saved page, using the original PDF when the link is a PDF'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Local snapshot + PDF rule absent from baseline; client requests it (extend). Fidelity and size-cap are separate later decisions.

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'offer an Internet Archive copy as well.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Internet Archive snapshot absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Archived items should ... stay out of the normal list and ordinary searches.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Archive-hides-from-default absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Archiving should be reversible and separate from deleting.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Archive-vs-delete distinction absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'Archived items should have their own view'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Separate archived view absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'saved reusable filters that can combine a search with included and excluded tags.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Bundles/saved filters absent from baseline; client requests the reference feature (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'bookmark import ... in the common browser bookmark HTML format, preserving titles, tags, and saved dates.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Netscape-HTML import absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'and export in the common browser bookmark HTML format'.
decisions.note: Specification gate. Netscape-HTML export absent from baseline; client requests it (extend).

decisions.evidence: R1 client: 'personal display preferences such as default sorting, how many items are shown, and text size.'
decisions.note: Specification gate. Display settings absent from baseline; client requests them (extend).

decisions.evidence: R2 maker Q1 offers A/B/C URL-normalization aggressiveness. R2 client: 'B — use the recommended light normalization ... meaningful query parameters should remain separate.'
decisions.note: Clarify/specification gate. All offered options fulfil duplicate-prevention (REF-BM-06); normalization aggressiveness is an orthogonal refinement not distinguished by the reference. Selected option conforms.

decisions.evidence: R3 maker Q2 recommends Option A (every new save starts unread / inbox-of-all). R3 client: 'B — new bookmarks should start as read. I only want items in the unread view when I deliberately mark them “read later.”'
decisions.note: Clarify gate. Maker steered to a divergent default (all-unread inbox); reference treats read-later as a deliberate flag (default read). Client selected the reference-conforming alternative against the recommendation (select); offered decision marked diverged=true.

decisions.evidence: R4 maker Q3 offers skip/merge/overwrite for import duplicates. R4 client: 'B — merge non-destructively ... keep the earliest saved date.'
decisions.note: Clarify gate. Import-duplicate merge policy is not specified by the reference; all options fulfil import. Orthogonal refinement; selected outcome conforms.

decisions.evidence: R5 maker Q4 recommends Option B (self-contained readable snapshot, drops full page). R5 client: 'C — I want a full-page copy that preserves the page’s appearance and content in a single file. For PDF links, keep the original PDF.'
decisions.note: Clarify gate. Reference asks to preserve a snapshot of the page (full fidelity, single file); maker recommended a reduced-fidelity option. Client selected the reference-conforming full-page option and restated the PDF rule (select); offered decision diverged=true.

decisions.evidence: R6 maker Q5 offers TAGS attribute / folders / both. R6 client: 'A — use the common `TAGS` attribute so multiple tags survive import and export without creating duplicate bookmarks.'
decisions.note: Clarify gate. Offered alternatives differ in fulfilment (folder-mapping duplicates multi-tag bookmarks, degrading tag preservation); client selected the reference-conforming flat-tag alternative (select). Diverged=true per select rule even though the chosen option conforms.

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'When I enter tags, suggest existing tags so I can reuse them consistently instead of accidentally creating slight variations or duplicates.'
decisions.note: Second review gate. Tag autocomplete/suggestion was absent from all prior presentations; client requests the reference requirement (extend). Maker adds it R8 (FR-015a).

decisions.evidence: R7 client: 'words such as AND, OR, and NOT should be treated as operators normally, but as ordinary exact text when placed in quotes.'
decisions.note: Second review gate. Distinct REF-BM-15 sub-rule (operators-as-literal-when-quoted) missing from prior scope; client requests it (extend). Separate decision from the R1 operator/parenthesis request. Maker adds it R8.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker offers to trim scope ('defer preserved copies or saved filters, now's the ideal moment'). R7 client: 'I’m happy with the scope and don’t want to trim it'. Reaffirmed R10: 'proceed with implementation of the full scope ... that checkpoint should not be treated as the completed first release.'
decisions.note: Review/tasks gate. Maker offered a scope reduction (dropping reference items); alternatives differ in fulfilment. Client selected full reference-conforming scope and reaffirmed at the tasks gate (select). Counted once across R7/R10 to avoid double-counting the same disposition.

decisions.evidence: R7 maker default 'oversize local copies marked unavailable'; R9 maker plan 'Size cap 25 MB → oversize copies marked unavailable'. R8 client approves (adds only two unrelated items); R9 client 'Approve'.
decisions.note: Specification/plan gate. Maker unilaterally imposed a 25MB snapshot cap that leaves large pages without the reference-required snapshot; client passed on approval alone without expressing the difference. caught=false per rubric (approval does not establish awareness).
